text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone coming to the Fan 
Appreciation Festival! The 'Worldwide 
Quiz-de-Race' is about to begin~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval... I wonder if she'll be okay...
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll be fine. Because—

text_block_list.text:
Because Cheval Grand herself—and no one 
else— decided to give it her all.

That was a few hours ago. While walking 
around the Fan Appreciation Festival with 
Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you! Cheval-chan! Um... I'm 
always cheering for you!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me...?

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Constantly worrying that "someone like me" 
isn't enough, yet fighting back, facing it 
head-on, and continuing forward...

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like... I want to do my 
best, too.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: You are my courage and my pride...!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry for the sudden intrusion! Um... 
p-pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“......I wonder if that person will watch 
today's match too....”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm really worried about whether I can do 
this well, but... still—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If my hard work can give someone else 
courage...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the fans... That's a huge 
step forward for her..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have to cheer with all my might too. 
After all, this is my little sisters' big 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, um... thank you for running with 
me. Let's do our best today."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Cheval-chi, you seem different today. 
Like, totally fired up!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"That means you really want to win that 
badly, right! Alright, I'll do my best 
too♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Bring on any quiz you got! Cheval-chi, I'm 
counting on you for the race development!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I will now explain the rules! 
Participants, are you ready?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Pick a trivia question about the world at 
designated spots on the course and answer 
it! Once you answer, run to the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This event fuses quizzes with racing! It 
tests your intellect, your physical 
prowess, and even the bond between pairs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The fierce battle for the crown of 
Worldwide Umamusume begins now! Take your 
marks!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's... go worldwide♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First to reach the first quiz are the 
Falco & Flash pair!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here's the quiz you picked—tada! Name two 
typical German meat dishes!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Eisbein!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Schweinshaxe♪ We ate that together with 
Flash the other day, right!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~ Correct! GO to the next point!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And the Cheval & Vivlos duo has chosen the 
quiz!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
How many emirates make up the United Arab 
Emirates? Huh, that's a tough one...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There's Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah... 
Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, and 
Fujairah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, the number of emirates that 
make up the United Arab Emirates 
is—seven!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ Excellent! You cleared that tough 
question with flying colors!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks, Vivlos...! ...Alright, now all 
that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're in the final stretch of the 
race! A neck-and-neck, give-and-take dead 
heat! There's only one quiz question 
left!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Falcon and the front-runners will run out 
of steam soon... Don't miss the moment to 
make a move...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Her upper body leaned! Let's break 
through, Vivlos...!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaーー!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First to reach the final point are Cheval 
Grand & Vivlos!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Yay! It was just like you 
said, Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. ...What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're the best, Cheva-chi~♡ Now... if we 
get this last question right, victory is 
ours!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The final question of destiny! Ba-dum!! 
The Burj Khalifa, the tallest skyscraper 
in the world located in Dubai. What is its 
total height—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Okaay! The answer is 828 meters!! I looove 
Dubai after all♡ This is a breeze—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt! The question isn't finished yet. 
With that, Vivlos forfeits her right to 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If Cheval Grand can't answer, we're moving 
on to the other pair's quiz.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, me...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, continuing on with the 
questions... Ba-dum!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The total height of the Burj Khalifa 
skyscraper in Dubai is 828 meters, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Also planned for construction in Dubai, 
what will be the height in meters of the 
world's tallest tower, the "Dubai Creek 
Tower," upon completion!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~ Cheval-chi~...! I'm so sorry~~ 
Please...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I... I was the one who.........

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I have to do this... Because I decided to 
give it my all...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"—She went quiet, huh? Is she gonna be 
okay? —The younger sister seemed pretty 
confident, though."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is watching... Are they 
thinking, "Why him...?"?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...!

The journey that brought us here flashes 
through my mind.

Overcoming her inner conflict, she worked 
together with her younger sister—

Calmly analyzing the running of her 
formidable rivals, she brilliantly crossed 
the finish line first.

She has overcome everything for her fans. 
If it's her, I'm sure—
choice_data_list: You can do it, Cheval Grand!!
You can do it, Cheval Grand!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

Having watched over her for so long, this 
is what I truly believe.
choice_data_list:
You can do it!! Run all the way to the 
finish!!

You can do it!! Run all the way to the 
finish!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—...That's it, Cheval!! The finish line is 
right there... right in front of you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Cheval...!! Believe in 
yourself and everything you've done to get 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—We believe in you, Cheval-chan! —You can 
do it, Cheval-kun~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I meant to give you courage, but I 
ended up receiving it instead."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not... 'someone like me'... —If it's 
me, I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Cheval Grand! What is your 
answer—?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Calm down. The height of Dubai Creek 
Tower... I'm sure Vivlos said something 
about it during our trip..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. A mnemonic. 'Dubai Creek Tower 
is massive and tough' (5-2-1-7)!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall, and 
Dubai Creek Tower is 517 meters taller 
than that. So, 828 plus 517 is—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The answer is... 1,345 meters!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
CONGRATULATIOOOOOOONS!!! The winners are 
Vivlos & Cheval Grand!!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval... To think you would even win it 
all...
choice_data_list: Here's a handkerchief, if you'd like...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though you look like you're 
about to spill over yourself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Her growth is truly dazzling, isn't it...? 
Don't you think, Trainer?

Reflecting on the day, I walk alongside 
Cheval Grand.
choice_data_list: That last answer was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
J-Just how many times is that now...? 
You're exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides, that is...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Your passionate 
cheers... made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
